notes: Interexo broker directory with 397 pages. Each page contains 30 broker records. Brokers are listed with their name and company affiliation. The broker_url is in format: /{country_state}/company/{company-slug}/{broker-name-slug} and company_url is in format: /{country_state}/company/{company-slug}. URLs can be constructed from the href attributes if needed. This is a broker directory, not a business listings site - each record represents a business broker/agent rather than a business for sale.
